title: MENTION OF TRIAL COURT DETAILS IN PRAYER CLAUSE WHEN AN APPLICATION IS FILED FOR QUASHING/STAY OF ORDER.
text:
KEY LINES:
Date :23/03/2023

FULL TEXT:
=: NOTICE ::
NO.RJ/ 06/2023
As directed by the Hon’ble the Acting Chief Justice, all
litigants/learned Advocate(s)/Party-in-Person(s) are requested
that as and when an application is filed for quashing of
FIR/order and if Trial Court proceedings has already been
registered then details of such proceedings should be
mentioned in prayer clause of the application and copy of
which also be filed as annexure.
By order of the Hon’ble Acting Chief Justice
Date :23/03/2023
